title: Why Black agencies failed: Ray Charles, Joe Adams and John Lee
summary: Thomas says Ray Charles now books himself, explains how his agency's new owner botched a complaint, and mentions John Lee managing Nancy Wilson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: What I'm trying to find out from you, since you're in the business, and this is for posterity... I'm talking from... This turns now into a Black entity.
Right.
Everyone we're talking about is Black and has been famous. Except... The big difference is that... Ray Charles made it and...
Thomas - 197
Yeah, because Ray Charles books himself now. He's got a guy that works for him, and he books himself. He's got big enough to do that.
I'd say Blueberry Hill made it. But what about the agencies? The agents and the personal managers? What happened to those agencies(?) in our field, and what...?

Well, see, I can say that my mistake was that I didn't stay in personal management. But I got a chance to make money and learn the business. But I happened to work with an office that the son was... We're not recording it now.
Yes.

And he sold the office to a guy that didn't know the business. See, now, he made a mistake on the biggest artists we had. He made a mistake on Ray Charles. Ray Charles was out in Was, I can't think of the guy that wrote up the article... And Ray Charles, he bombed in Was when he played there. He was either high or something was wrong. And the guy gave him a bad writeup. So he called Ray Charles' office, and he was given... Now, he didn't know that Ray Charles' manager was like that. He had Ray Charles on the phone, but the manager was on the extension. And he was giving Joe Adams the lip. He was talking like
Thomas - 198

"You should get rid of Joe Adams." But Ray Charles is his own boss, see. Joe Adams was his manager. You couldn't tell him to get rid of his manager. But he just didn't know Ray Charles. See, Ray Charles is a brilliant... To my thinking, he's brilliant. He's blind but he's brilliant.
Well, there's another (?)...
Which one?
He's blind. Now, what happens with John Lee, a guy like him that's...
Well, John's still...
Has he succeeded or haas he not?

He's still doing all right. I don't know what he's got... He's in California now. You know, he did such a good job on Nancy Wilson... She left him. But he did such a good job on her she came back to him. That was her husband getting involved.
Yeah. Was Joe Williams or Cannonball Adderley involved in that...?
Yeah.
And I guess Nat Adderley, and... Did he have some of that?
No.
He seemed to be very successful.
I don't know whether he...
Thomas - 199
He had a (?) percentage just hitting every now and then, but not on a business basis...
I don't know what'all he's doing. But he's in California. I think he's doing... See, George Shearing put him in the business. And...
